faqs.answer: The LOQ 15IRX9 platform has two SO-DIMM slots and two M.2 PCIe 4.0 SSD slots. Check the exact SKU and Lenovo maintenance guide before buying parts.

products.source: AMD official product specifications; demo price and stock
products.title: AMD Ryzen 5 7600 Desktop Processor (AM5)
products.description: A 6-core, 12-thread Zen 4 desktop processor for the AM5 platform. It boosts up to 5.1GHz, has a 65W default TDP, supports DDR5, and includes Radeon integrated graphics and a Wraith Stealth thermal solution in the boxed SKU. A compatible AM5 motherboard and DDR5 memory are required; cooler and graphics behavior depend on the exact package and system configuration.
features: Integrated Radeon graphics and boxed Wraith Stealth cooler

specifications.label: Memory
specifications.value: DDR5, dual channel; supported speed depends on DIMM configuration

specifications.label: Integrated graphics
specifications.value: AMD Radeon Graphics, 2 graphics cores, up to 2200MHz

specifications.label: Thermal solution
specifications.value: AMD Wraith Stealth included with boxed processor

faqs.question: What motherboard socket does it use?
faqs.answer: The Ryzen 5 7600 uses AMD Socket AM5. Check the motherboard CPU support list and BIOS version before installation.

faqs.question: Does it include a cooler?
faqs.answer: AMD lists the Wraith Stealth thermal solution with the boxed processor. Tray/OEM packages may differ.

faqs.question: Can it run without a graphics card?
faqs.answer: It includes basic Radeon integrated graphics, so a discrete GPU is not required for display output when the motherboard has a supported display connector.

faqs.question: Does it use DDR4 memory?
faqs.answer: No. The AM5 Ryzen 5 7600 platform uses DDR5 memory.

products.source: Intel ARK official specifications; demo price and stock
products.title: Intel Core i5-14600K Desktop Processor
products.description: An unlocked 14th Gen desktop CPU with 14 cores (6 Performance-cores plus 8 Efficient-cores), 20 threads, and up to 5.3GHz turbo frequency. Intel specifies 125W processor base power and 181W maximum turbo power. It uses the LGA1700 socket, supports DDR4 or DDR5 depending on the motherboard, and includes Intel UHD Graphics 770; a suitable cooler is required and is not included with the boxed K SKU.

specifications.label: Thermal solution
specifications.value: No included thermal solution; choose a cooler rated for system power

faqs.question: Which socket does the Core i5-14600K use?
faqs.answer: It uses Intel FCLGA1700. Check the motherboard CPU support list and BIOS version for this exact processor.

faqs.question: Can it use DDR4 memory?
faqs.answer: The processor supports DDR4-3200 and DDR5-5600, but a motherboard supports one memory type, not both.

faqs.question: Does it have integrated graphics?
faqs.answer: Yes. Intel specifies UHD Graphics 770.

faqs.question: Is a CPU cooler included?
faqs.answer: Intel lists no thermal solution for this boxed K processor. Purchase a compatible cooler separately.

products.source: ASUS India official specifications; demo price and stock

products.description: A compact, factory-overclocked GeForce RTX 4060 graphics card with 8GB GDDR6 memory and a 2.5-slot dual-fan cooler. ASUS specifies a 2535MHz OC-mode clock, one HDMI 2.1a output, three DisplayPort 1.4a outputs, one 8-pin power connector, and a recommended 550W PSU. faqs.question: How much video memory does this card have?
faqs.answer: This ASUS model has 8GB of GDDR6 memory on a 128-bit interface.

faqs.answer: The card is 227.2mm long and 2.5 slots thick. Compare those measurements with your case clearance and adjacent expansion slots.

faqs.question: How many displays can it connect?

products.source: Samsung India / Samsung Semiconductor official specifications; demo price and stock
products.title: Samsung 990 EVO Plus 4TB NVMe SSD (MZ-V9S4T0BW)
products.description: A 4TB M.2 2280 NVMe solid-state drive for client PCs. Samsung specifies a PCIe 4.0 x4 / PCIe 5.0 x2 interface, sequential reads up to 7,250MB/s, sequential writes up to 6,300MB/s, and a five-year limited warranty or 2,400TBW limit. Confirm your motherboard's M.2 slot support and heatsink requirements before installation.

specifications.label: Sequential read
specifications.value: Up to 7,250MB/s, depending on host system

specifications.label: Sequential write
specifications.value: Up to 6,300MB/s, depending on host system

specifications.label: Warranty
specifications.value: Five-year limited warranty or 2,400TBW, whichever comes first

faqs.question: Will it work in any M.2 slot?
faqs.answer: It is an M.2 2280 NVMe drive. The host must support NVMe over PCIe; check the motherboard or laptop manual for slot size and supported PCIe generations.

faqs.question: Are the advertised speeds guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Samsung labels them up to 7,250MB/s read and 6,300MB/s write; actual performance depends on the host system and workload.

faqs.question: What is the warranty?
faqs.answer: Samsung specifies a five-year limited warranty or 2,400TBW, whichever occurs first, subject to its terms.

faqs.question: Does the drive include a heatsink?
faqs.answer: The listed MZ-V9S4T0BW model is the bare M.2 drive. Check the package and motherboard heatsink options before installation.

products.source: TP-Link official product specifications; demo price and stock
products.title: TP-Link TL-WN725N 150Mbps Wireless N Nano USB Adapter
products.description: A miniature USB 2.0 Wi-Fi adapter for adding 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n wireless connectivity to a compatible desktop or notebook. TP-Link specifies a theoretical link rate of up to 150Mbps, internal antenna, WPA/WPA2 security, and an 18.6 x 15 x 7.1mm body. Real throughput depends on the router, radio conditions, driver, and operating system; verify the adapter's hardware version and driver support before purchase.
features: WPA/WPA2 wireless security listed by TP-Link

specifications.label: Security
specifications.value: 64/128-bit WEP, WPA, WPA2, WPA-PSK/WPA2-PSK, and IEEE 802.1X; version support varies

specifications.label: System compatibility
specifications.value: TP-Link lists Windows, macOS, and Linux; verify driver availability for the hardware version and OS

faqs.question: Does the 150Mbps rate mean internet download speed?
faqs.answer: No. It is a theoretical Wi-Fi link rate. Actual throughput varies with router, interference, distance, driver, and network conditions.

faqs.question: Does this adapter support 5GHz Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: The TL-WN725N specifications list 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n; they do not list 5GHz support.

faqs.question: Will it fit without blocking nearby USB ports?
faqs.answer: It is a nano adapter measuring 18.6 x 15 x 7.1mm, though clearance depends on the computer's port layout.

faqs.question: Will it work with my operating system?
faqs.answer: TP-Link lists Windows, macOS, and Linux support, but the required driver depends on the adapter hardware version and OS release. Check TP-Link's download page before purchasing.
